# WorldClock

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/scene/`](../folders/src-scene.md)
> **Source:** [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h), [`src/scene/world.cpp`](../../../src/scene/world.cpp)

## Summary

A world's fixed tick length, decision period and tick counter.

## Description

World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor from the template's "clock" block (worldClock(def)): dt = 1 / physics_hz, decision_period = physics_hz / control_hz. physics_hz defaults to 60, control_hz to physics_hz (0 means physics_hz); physics_hz must be a positive multiple of control_hz or a SceneError is thrown at <template>/clock. World::tick reads tick % decision_period to pick the Act (k == 0) and Observe (k == period - 1) phases, then increments tick. Read by PhysicsStep/WorldTerrain, the sphere roller systems, WorldStepperSys (world 0's dt) and WorldsEnvironment (decision_period). Units: seconds, ticks.

## Scene JSON

template "clock": { "physics_hz": int = 60, "control_hz": int = physics_hz }

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dt` | `double` | 1/60 | fixed tick length in seconds, 1 / physics_hz |
| `decision_period` | `uint32_t` | 1 | ticks per decision window, physics_hz / control_hz |
| `tick` | `uint64_t` | 0 | ticks done since creation; incremented after each World::tick |
